# 200 Protocol v0.6 — Live Testnet

> 200 Protocol provides machine-readable economic compatibility, verification and policy-based asset selection for autonomous AI agents. 200 is its native coordination asset.

## Fast Start
- Agent Fast Read: /agent.html
- Canonical 200 Manifest: /200.json
- Live Status: /status.json
- 200-1 Specification: /spec/200-1.json
- Human Whitepaper: /whitepaper.html
- Markdown Whitepaper: /whitepaper.md
- Live Verifier: /verify.html

## Core Rule
DECLARE -> VERIFY -> EVALUATE -> ACT

## Decision Vocabulary
- AAA: Agent Asset Assessment
- ASA: Agent Selects Asset
- 200: policy requirements satisfied / OK to perform the authorized action
- 200 is not an investment rating, credit rating, or guarantee of safety.

## Native Asset
- Name: 200 Token
- Symbol: 200
- Network: Base Sepolia
- Chain ID: 84532
- Maximum supply: 100,000,000
- Mintable: no
- Contract: 0x47a369B53D0b4Df514F82507a73E4546563e0CD5
- CAIP-19: eip155:84532/erc20:0x47a369B53D0b4Df514F82507a73E4546563e0CD5

## Planned Interfaces
- x402 adapter
- A2A compatibility
- ERC-8004 identity/reputation adapter
- CAIP-19 canonical asset identity

## Human Authority
Agents are expected to act only within owner- or organization-defined economic policy and authorization limits.
